links.surface: عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن عمار بن سعد

notes: «مؤذن رسول الله» describes the narrator and is not part of the surface
«حدثني أبي عن أبيه عن جده» gives three bare relations; none is named in the text, so none is completed
The Prophet is the end of the chain; the last link is the grandfather, whose act of reporting is the saying
